Metrics.Name: intune.detected_apps.catalog_size
Metrics.Description: Total distinct app/version/platform rows in the Intune detectedApps catalog.

Metrics.Name: intune.detected_apps.device_count
Metrics.Description: Devices reporting a detected app installed, by app name and platform, summed across versions. Bounded by the central cardinality limiter: past cardinality.per_metric_limit the top apps by device count are kept and the tail folds into app_name="other".
